## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)

- [ ] check_dual_identity_complete invoked between fetcher and differ (Considerations [Reliability])
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py::test_invariant_phase_ordering
- [ ] compute_mutations receives quarantine_set and seed_mutations from invariant phase
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py::test_kwargs_propagated
- [ ] Post-emit filter (structural quarantine guard): mutations whose target is in quarantine_set are stripped from the manifest BEFORE applier dispatch — belt-and-suspenders with differ's _emit() check
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py::test_post_emit_filter_strips_quarantined
- [ ] applier dispatch routes action='repair_property' to inbound_repair_property
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py::test_applier_dispatch_repair_property
- [ ] schema_drift_signal follow-ons from applier are routed back to invariants._report_schema_drift before pass closure (same-pass bug filing)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py::test_schema_drift_signal_routed_same_pass
- [ ] End-to-end fixture: drift issue (DIG-X) quarantined + orphan (DIG-2) gets repair_property + DIG-X has no other mutation in manifest
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_invariant_phase.py::test_end_to_end_drift_and_orphan
- [ ] Existing test_reconcile_once.py regressions pass
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_reconcile_once.py

## Implementation Notes

```python
# reconcile.py — between fetcher and applier
jira_snapshot = fetcher.collect(...)
quarantine_set, seed_repairs = invariants.check_dual_identity_complete(jira_snapshot, repo_root)
mutations = differ.compute_mutations(local_state, jira_state,
                                     quarantine_set=frozenset(quarantine_set),
                                     seed_mutations=seed_repairs)
# Belt-and-suspenders post-emit filter (F4 structural guard)
mutations = [m for m in mutations if m.target not in quarantine_set]

# Dispatch applier; collect follow-ons
for m in mutations:
    result = applier.dispatch(m, client)
    if result.get('follow_on', {}).get('kind') == 'schema_drift_signal':
        # Route back to invariants — same pass, before close
        invariants._report_schema_drift(
            result['follow_on']['issue_key'],
            result['follow_on']['reason'],
            repo_root, ticket_cli, alert_store,
        )
```

The post-emit filter is the structural guard against future differ emit branches added without a quarantine check (F4). Even if differ's _emit() helper is bypassed, reconcile.py strips quarantined targets before applier dispatch.

The schema_drift_signal routing in reconcile.py closes the dd-3 loop: applier emits the signal (no direct invariants import), reconcile.py routes it (no orchestrator coupling in invariants.py), invariants._report_schema_drift files the bug — same pass.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
